official.deadline_note: No scholarship closing date; scholarship is assessed automatically with the admission application. Griffith recommends applying mid-November for a Trimester 1 start, mid-April for a Trimester 2 start and mid-July for a Trimester 3 start to allow time for assessment and visa processing.
official.application_cycle: Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027 (listed as 'International Academic Merit Scholarship (T3, 2025, or 2026 or 2027)')
official.status_note: The official scholarships and finance listing shows the International Academic Merit Scholarship (T3, 2025, or 2026 or 2027) as available with intakes Trimester 1, 2 or 3 and closing date 'No application required'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scholarship covers 20% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees only for the 'Duration' of the program on meeting the ongoing enrolment requirements.
official.funding_period: 20% of tuition fees per trimester for the whole degree
benefits: Valid for your whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing eligibility requirements.
If you are awarded the Scholarship in your letter of offer the deposit displayed will be a reduced amount to reflect the 20% Scholarship.
Each deduction will be applied by the census date of each relevant trimester of the program.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand.
Have a minimum GPA in previous studies of 4.5 on a 7 point scale or equivalent.
Satisfy all academic and English language entry requirements for your chosen undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program.
Be a full-time student starting in Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027.
requirements: Students must be International Fee Paying to qualify for the scholarship and each scholarship deduction; any change from International Fee Paying student status will result in the scholarship being withdrawn.
Students must be enrolled full-time and making progress in their studies that meets your student visa requirements to receive and maintain the scholarship, unless credit prevents full-time enrolment.
To maintain scholarship eligibility, students must pass all courses for each trimester of study and successfully progress on to enrol in the next trimester.
Students must remain enrolled in the program for which the scholarship offer was made, which is stated on the Letter of Offer issued by Griffith International Admissions.
Should a student withdraw or cancel for any reason, the scholarship amount is non-refundable.
documents: All prior academic transcripts and certificates (latest transcript acceptable if studies are not yet completed).
Copy of English test results (if available).
Copy of current valid passport or official photo identification (if available).
Copy of Australian visa grant notification (if currently or previously held).
Portfolio or audition where the chosen degree program requires one.
Certified copies of documents, with certified translation for any document not in English; additional documents may be requested depending on country of citizenship.
selection_criteria: Assessed on admission against the published threshold: minimum GPA in previous studies of 4.5 on a 7 point scale or equivalent (see the official Minimum GPA criteria PDF).
If you are on a packaged offer with a pathway provider, your scholarship eligibility will be assessed when your final grades are provided to Griffith University.
No separate scholarship application, interview or competitive panel applies.
coverage: 20% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees only for the 'Duration' of the program.
The duration is defined as the 'Program Length' of the first degree program as stated in your Letter of Offer, less any credit received for previous study.
Each deduction will be applied by the census date of each relevant trimester of the program.
Tuition fees only - living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered.
application_method: Apply to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at Griffith University.
Griffith assesses your application for scholarship eligibility.
If you are successful, Griffith will advise you in your Letter of Offer, in 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'.
official.application_route: No separate application - apply to study at Griffith University (online or via a registered Griffith agent) and Griffith assesses scholarship eligibility automatically, advising the outcome in the Letter of Offer.
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - open to citizens of countries other than Australia and New Zealand.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Most undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs. Excluded: Bachelor of Medical Science, Bachelor of Dental Health Science, Doctor of Medicine, Master of Dentistry, Master of Speech Pathology, MBA (program code 5158), Graduate Diploma of Flight Management, Higher Degree Research, non-award, Study Abroad Program, Diploma programs, Masters Qualifying Program, GELI English language programs, part-time-only programs and partner-delivered programs.
official.duration: Valid for your whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing eligibility requirements
official.description: The International Academic Merit Scholarship recognises international students with strong academic results applying for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs at Griffith University. The award value is 20% of tuition fees, valid for the whole degree subject to ongoing eligibility, and requires no separate application: apply to study at Griffith and successful applicants are advised in their Letter of Offer.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship (coursework tuition fee waiver)
official.english_requirement: Scholarship page sets no separate score: Griffith University academic and English language entry requirements apply for the chosen program, including results of previous study and English language proficiency.

not_confirmed: funding_amount - the official page publishes 20% of tuition fees (a percentage), not a fixed monetary figure, so no bare number can be recorded
a specific IELTS/TOEFL minimum score - the scholarship page only states that Griffith's academic and English language entry requirements for the chosen program apply
an institutional nomination deadline - none exists; the official listing states 'No application required'
verification.notes: Checked the official scholarship page (award value, duration, eligibility, terms and conditions), the international scholarships listing (intakes and closing date) and the international applications page (application documents and recommended application timing) on griffith.edu.au.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic 20% tuition discount, not a competitive award: Griffith assesses it against your admission application, so your real deadline is the admission application itself rather than any scholarship closing date. You need a GPA of at least 4.5 on a 7-point scale (check the official GPA conversion sheet against your home grading system before you apply) and you must commence in Trimester 3 2025 or any 2026 or 2027 trimester - a deferral to 2028 forfeits it. Once enrolled, the discount only continues each trimester if you stay full-time and pass every course. Budget for the remaining 80% of tuition plus living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, visa fees and flights, none of which this scholarship touches.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants (non-Australia/NZ citizenship) with a 4.5+/7 GPA entering a non-excluded Griffith coursework degree who want a guaranteed tuition reduction without writing an essay or competing for limited places.
application_readiness_checklist: Convert your grades to Griffith's 7-point scale using the official Minimum GPA criteria PDF and confirm you clear 4.5 before you apply.

Check your target degree against the published exclusion list (MBA, Doctor of Medicine, dentistry, speech pathology, medical science, flight management and partner-delivered programs) before choosing it.
Prepare certified copies of all academic transcripts and certificates, English test results, passport and any Australian visa grant notice, with the required certifier details on each certified page.
Time your application to Griffith's recommended windows - mid-November for a Trimester 1 start, mid-April for Trimester 2, mid-July for Trimester 3 - so there is time for assessment and your visa.
After receiving your Letter of Offer, check the 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees' line and the reduced deposit to confirm the 20% scholarship was applied.
common_rejection_risks: Your degree is on the exclusion list (for example MBA 5158, Doctor of Medicine, Master of Dentistry, Master of Speech Pathology, Bachelor of Medical Science, Graduate Diploma of Flight Management) - the scholarship is never assessed for these.
You entered through a Griffith College pathway: eligibility is only assessed once your final grades are provided to Griffith, so a weaker final year can cost you the award.
You defer your commencement to 2028 or later, which the terms explicitly rule out regardless of GPA.
You drop below full-time enrolment or fail a course, and the deduction stops for later trimesters.
Your International Fee Paying status changes (for example through a change in residency pathway), which withdraws the scholarship.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80% of tuition fees for every trimester of the program, plus living and accommodation costs, Overseas Student Health Cover, student visa costs and flights, none of which are covered.
document_audit: Certification must include the exact statement 'This is a certified true copy of the original as sighted by me' plus the certifier's name, signature, date, professional registration number and occupation.
You cannot certify your own documents and family members cannot certify them - use a Justice of the Peace, notary, lawyer, embassy official or police officer.
Transcripts in a language other than English need a certified translation alongside a certified copy of the original.
Packaged-offer applicants should supply final grade results to Griffith promptly, because scholarship assessment waits on those grades.
If you studied at an Australian or New Zealand university you can share documents via My eQuals instead of paper certified copies.
alerts: The award window is tied to commencement: Trimester 3 2025 or any 2026 or 2027 trimester only; students who defer to 2028 or later are not eligible.
There is no scholarship application form and no closing date - but Griffith recommends applying mid-November (T1), mid-April (T2) or mid-July (T3) so your offer and visa can be processed in time.
The discount is contingent, not guaranteed once you start: you must pass all courses each trimester and remain full-time to keep it.

If you are awarded a higher-value Griffith scholarship (more than 20% of tuition, such as the 50% Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship), the higher award applies instead - note that scholarship has a 28 November 2026 closing date for Trimester 1 and does require a separate application with a personal statement.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to study online through Griffith's International Application System (or via a registered Griffith agent); Griffith assesses admission and scholarship eligibility together and advises the result in the Letter of Offer.
